title: Splat's Savory Jerusalem Delight
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish combining the sweetness of Jerusalem artichokes with the savory taste of umami. This recipe is perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Toss the Jerusalem artichokes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a small pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Splat's umami powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Toss the roasted Jerusalem artichokes with the umami powder mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
